description: List orders in sevDesk: offers (Angebote, AN), order confirmations (Auftragsbestätigungen, AB) and delivery notes (Lieferscheine, LI), with compact rows: number, type, status, contact, date, net/tax/gross. Filter by type, status (draft = Entwurf, sent = versendet, rejected = abgelehnt, accepted = angenommen, partially_invoiced, invoiced = berechnet), contactId, exact order number and date range. Type and number are also checked here (up to 1,000 rows scanned per call; total left out, filteredLocally set). Page with offset = nextOffset while hasMore. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_order_get for details and positions.

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

status.description: draft 100, sent 200, rejected 300, accepted 500, partially_invoiced 750, invoiced 1000.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

name: sevdesk_orders_list
title: List sevDesk orders
